posts.text:
New in Claude Code: /ultraplan

Claude builds an implementation plan for you on the web. You can read it and edit it, then run the plan on the web or back in your terminal.

Available now in preview for all users with CC on the web enabled.
posts.notes: HIGHEST signal this scan. /ultraplan: cloud-based planning handoff from local CLI to Claude Code on Web running in plan mode (Opus 4.6 in Cloud Container Runtime). You draft in cloud while working in terminal; browser comment/edit loop; execute on web OR back in terminal. 765K views, 4,926 bookmarks in first ~18 hours. Direct relevance: this is the spec→plan→execute separation of concerns that matches our orchestrator PLAN vs WORKER split. Worth an /ingest-post entry documenting the handoff mechanism.

posts.text: I want to do some streams where I work with non-technical people using Claude Code to figure out how they might be able to improve their process. My feeling is that just a few tips could make a big difference in efficiency. Any mutuals interested?
posts.notes: Non-technical user workflow streams proposal. 180K views, 694 replies. Signals Anthropic's direct interest in non-technical user adoption patterns. Relevant to MAYTT cousin-Ali scenario (non-technical end user).

posts.text: not an April Fools joke, we rewrote the Claude Code renderer to use a virtual viewport. you can use your mouse, the prompt input stays at the bottom, and a lot more small UX wins people have been asking for. it's experimental so give us your feedback
posts.notes: Virtual viewport renderer rewrite for Claude Code: mouse support, prompt stays at bottom, NO_FLICKER mode, 85% flicker reduction. 285K views. Quote-tweet of Boris Cherny announcement. Relevant to tmux rendering UX — cmux-style native terminal patterns converging with Claude Code's own renderer direction.
